meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Markdown 变成公众号文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 Markdown 写公众号,希望快速排版发布。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Markdown into WeChat Official Account articles.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write WeChat posts in Markdown and want quick formatting and publishing.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会调用「md2wechat」工具,把 Markdown 转成微信公众号用的 HTML,并可预览、生成配图/封面、建草稿、按指定风格写作、拟标题、去除 AI 痕迹。输出由工具实际运行决定。
howto.when: 当用户要求把 Markdown 转成微信公众号文章、生成配图或封面、创建草稿等公众号相关操作,或询问支持哪些主题/模板时,该技能会接管并先用命令查询可用选项。

say.text: 把这份 Markdown 转成公众号文章 HTML。
say.note: 会先检查文件再转换,生成 HTML。

say.text: 给这篇文章生成一张封面图。
say.note: 优先走封面生成,缺凭证时先给图片方案。

say.text: 给这篇稿子建议几个公众号标题。
say.note: 返回标题候选,不直接发布。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the md2wechat CLI to turn Markdown into WeChat article HTML, preview it, generate covers/images, create drafts, write in creator styles, suggest titles, and remove AI traces.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to convert Markdown to WeChat HTML, generate an article image/cover, create a draft, suggest titles, remove AI traces, or asks what themes/providers are supported.

say_en.text: Turn this Markdown into WeChat article HTML.
say_en.note: Runs inspect/convert and outputs the HTML.

say_en.text: Generate a cover image for this article.
say_en.note: Prefers cover generation or plans the image if no credentials.

say_en.text: Suggest a few WeChat titles for this post.
